status: setup plan and toolchain verification complete; protected creation blocked pending human grants/operator action

operator-git-root.description: Operator creates the directory, runs git init, and makes the initial baseline commit. Workers must not run git init/commit/push in the outer repo; new roots are separate repositories registered in the outer repo only by the operator.

operator-ligature-bundle.description: Install the approved checksum-verified Ligature 1.4.3 bundle into tools/ligature/ (ligature.pyz, SHA256SUMS, PROVENANCE.json). No Ligature sanctioned verb writes this tree; a human grant for tools/ligature/** is required before any worker-assisted copy.

operator-ligature-init.description: Operator runs the root-local ligature.pyz init and authors the descriptor/write policy (T2 policy). project-descriptor.json, .ligature/**, ci/**, and project-state are operator/Ligature managed.

operator-managed-file.description: Operator-managed file per the approved write-set design; no worker edit.

human-policy.description: T2 normative policy/spec content; human authoring/review. accept-policy is a human checkpoint.

sanctioned-scaffold-crate.description: After the descriptor declares the crate, run ligature.pyz scaffold-crate --issue <stage-id> --crate <name> --grant-id <id> --json under an exact active crates/<name>/Cargo.toml grant. Not a free-form manifest editor.

sanctioned-configure-crate-verus.description: For a declared Verus crate only: configure-crate --profile cargo-verus under an exact Cargo.toml grant. Historical vstd-version-unavailable refusal (local escalation #124) must be reported, not hand-edited.

operator-lockfile.description: No sanctioned Ligature verb writes Cargo.lock. Operator generates/refreshes the independent lock with the pinned toolchain, or issues an exact path grant plus a reviewed manual step. Workers must not hand-edit locks.

operator-toolchain-file.description: No sanctioned Ligature verb writes nested rust-toolchain.toml or .cargo/config.toml. Operator authors the verifier-specific pin (and creusot-std Nix patch). Workers must not hand-edit these files.

operator-source-pin.description: Intake needs upstream/** at the immutable pin plus upstream/upstream-pin.json. upstream/** is protected in the proposed write set; the checkout is created by the operator or by an intake issue with an exact upstream/** grant. Network fetch is an operator action.

worker-allowed.description: Inside descriptor allowed_roots; worker authoring is permitted by the approved #177 write-set design.

companion_output_supported.note: 0.12.0-dev: proof patterns must resolve under the crate prefix; absolute external .coma is rejected. Keep .coma and proof.json in rust/<crate>/verif/ and archive hashed copies under analysis/<stage>/results-creusot/.

shared_rules.independent_roots: Each root is its own Git repository and Ligature project. No shared mutable manifest, lock, ledger, closure directory, target, or proof output.
shared_rules.targets: All Cargo/CBMC native build targets are task-specific under /tmp/opencode/p4-<root>-<stage>/. No repository-local target/ tree.
shared_rules.proof_outputs: Per-tool durable outputs stay separate under each root's analysis/<stage>/results-<tool>/; Creusot's raw verif/ stays in-crate and is archived by hash.
shared_rules.no_flake_edit: No flake.nix/flake.lock edit and no install outside Nix. Existing shells are reused; missing P4 shells are a toolchain finding, not a worker flake edit.
shared_rules.no_commit_push: Workers do not commit or push. New-root initial commits and outer-repo submodule registration are operator actions.
shared_rules.no_blanket_grant: Mechanical protected operations require the matching sanctioned verb plus an exact human-issued issue/path grant, or operator action.
